[A10] **Current contract, 2026-09-22:** the [public pre-implementation decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/400#issuecomment-5770922734) records the supported declarations, corrects stale source claims and explicitly amends acceptance before takeover. It governs where the original audit/examples below differ. The parent #400+#403 bundle depends on [processor #95](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/95) for the actual generated-VID parameter path. No implementation has begun; executor and independent reviewers must be assigned at takeover.

---


Found by the milestone 4 declaration audit at dev f46215cf (m4-audit/REPORT.md, section 2.6).

## Objective and evidence

Since 2026-08-12 the 0x680 group is an ABI the deleted applicant no longer reads (`sw/builder/endstation_builder.py` lines 1946 to 1953; `docs/reference/REGISTER_MAP.md` lines 1055 and 1057). The `srp:` section still accepts twelve keys (`_srp_section`, lines 1653 to 1681). Where each one ends:

- `timers_ms` (join, leave, leaveall): `lwsrp_csr_defaults.svh` and the plan. The processor's `KL_srp_top` has `JOIN_MS_P` 200, `PERIODIC_MS_P` 1000 and `LEAVE_MS_P` 5000 (`protocol-processor/hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv` lines 73 to 77) and `protocol_processor_top.sv` lines 2111 to 2122 pass none of them. A config stating leave 600 builds a 5000 ms engine beside a 600 in a scratch word.
- `bandwidth_limit_pct`: the builder's budget refusal only (lines 1812 to 1838); `KL_srp_admission.sv` lines 74 to 83 carry their own constants.
- `stream_dmac_base`: 0x688 is scratch and the processor takes its destination address from MAAP (`hdl/ieee1722/maap/KL_maap.sv` lines 97 to 99).
- `class_queue`: the queue chain is not instantiated since VERSION 0x0056 (`docs/reference/EGRESS_QUEUE_MAP.md` lines 3 to 11).
- `tspec.policy`, `max_frame_bytes`, `interval_frames`: 0x690 is scratch; the processor derives MaxFrameSize from the wire width (REGISTER_MAP.md line 1057).
- `enable_at_reset`, `talker_declare_at_reset`: the firmware ORs both bits on (`sw/firmware/milan_baremetal/milan_baremetal.c` line 1003).
- `vid` reaches `LWSRP_VID`, `AAF_CTRL[27:16]` and the CRF tag through the firmware (lines 1001 to 1002; `hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv` lines 1194 and 4975). The processor's Domain default is `DOM_DEF_VID_P = 2` at `KL_srp_top.sv` line 80, a submodule default nothing drives from the config. They agree today because both say 2.
- `accumulated_latency_ns` stays live (REGISTER_MAP.md line 1061); `sr_class` A is by directive; `rtl_table` is header ownership.

## Authority and scope

- `docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md` section 1 (the lwSRP rows and "the CSR half survives"), `sw/builder/README-parameters.md` "Reservation table"; Milan v1.2 4.2.7.1.1 Table 4.3 for the MRP timers; the processor's parameter surface (`protocol_processor_top.sv` lines 60 to 140, `hdl/milan/KL_pp_shadow.sv` lines 177 to 230).
- A decision first, per key, recorded on this issue: route (expose the timer and default-VID parameters at `protocol_processor_top` and `KL_pp_shadow` and bind them from the generated headers the way `N_STREAM_IN_P` is bound at `milan_datapath.sv` line 6563), retire (a `ConfigError` naming the reason, as `cluster_mapping.rule` does), or keep as documented ABI scratch with the REGISTER_MAP row saying so. The VID must end with one source.

Out of scope: SRP engine behaviour, the deleted applicant, the queue chain (#259 decided its absence), the register-map generator (#50).

## Acceptance and validation

1. Every `srp:` key is classified in ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md section 3 as consumed (consumer named) or refused; no key lands in a scratch word without its row saying scratch.
2. If routed: the processor parameter is bound from `gen/adp_shape_defaults.svh` or `gen/lwsrp_csr_defaults.svh`, proven by a `test_builder.py` gate of the 23 series (header to `Instance()` parameter) and a Verilator check that a changed leave time changes the engine's Leave timer.
3. The VID has one source: `DOM_DEF_VID_P` is driven from the config or the CSR word, and a gate fails when the two could differ.
4. `test_builder.py` gates 18a to 18d and 20a stay green; a submodule bump, if needed, follows `docs/reference/SUBMODULES.md`; no em dash on added lines.

## Lane and review

Executor: unassigned. Independent reviewer: unassigned. Assigned by the manager when the lane opens.

comments.body: [A10] Scope note from the #398 decision: the firmware's `LWSRP_CTRL` OR 3 override of `srp.enable_at_reset` and `srp.talker_declare_at_reset` is left unchanged by the #398 lane and is decided here with the per-key route, retire or scratch decision. This lane's acceptance 1 covers it.

[A10] PRE-IMPLEMENTATION DECISION (2026-09-22)

Current-dev consumer audit at b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8 corrects the old line references and several stale ownership claims. The following dispositions are adopted under the maintainer's delegated decision authority before any implementation:

| Declaration | Supported meaning |
| --- | --- |
| sr_class | A-only validation, not an engine-programming control. |
| vid | Product startup/default 2, required by Milan 4.2.7.2.1. Route the generated value through the parent wrapper and donor top to KL_srp_top.DOM_DEF_VID_P. Reject other shipping defaults. |
| timers_ms | Fixed-profile assertions: join 200, leave 5000, leaveall 10000 ms; the last names the lower bound of the actual randomized 10-15 s interval. Reject overrides and verify donor constants/range. No timer routing. |
| bandwidth_limit_pct | Build-time budget from 1 through 75%; lower values are stricter build policy, not a changed live admission ceiling. |
| tspec.policy / interval_frames | Derived wire TSpec only; refuse pinned policy and interval_frames other than 1. |
| class_queue / numeric stream_dmac_base / derived-policy max_frame_bytes | Explicit legacy ABI/table scratch; never claim live scheduling, allocation or declaration behavior. A declared talker still requires MAAP. |
| enable_at_reset / talker_declare_at_reset | Live cold-reset admission controls. Preserve firmware OR 3 enforcing normal boot admission. These bits are not scratch and do not enable the processor's SRP engine. |
| accumulated_latency_ns / rtl_table | Existing live latency / builder-publication ownership retained. |

Evidence: endstation_builder.py _srp_section and reset generation; milan_datapath.sv:1583-1592,1906-1909,5260-5262 (live admission), :7395-7400 (wire TSpec/latency); milan_csr.sv:359-361 (queue bits); protocol_processor_top.sv:2136-2149 and KL_srp_top.sv:73-80 (independent defaults); KL_pp_prng.sv:156 (LeaveAll range). Milan 4.2.7.1.1 Table 4.3, 4.2.7.2.1 and 4.3.3.1/.2 constrain these decisions.

AC3 is preserved structurally: equality checks alone are insufficient. Donor prerequisite https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/95 exposes and tests the existing 16-bit default parameter before the parent pin changes. 'One source' covers the supported generated startup/default and firmware boot policy; existing diagnostic RW overrides remain documented, and operational Domain adoption continues. No perpetual equality claim is made for arbitrary manual writes to separate diagnostic registers.

The acceptance contract is clarified before takeover: classify every leaf by its real consumer/validator or explicit scratch role; reject unsupported values by name; prove each generated-VID binding hop and its reset/boot/network-adoption behavior; distinguish live reset bits from firmware boot policy in execution tests; retain gates 18a-18d and 20a plus complete donor/parent validation. Since timers are not routed, the original conditional changed-Leave-time test is inapplicable. No test is disabled to obtain green.

Dependency #95 is now explicit. The owner-authorized #400+#403 bundle remains the planned parent lane; executor/reviewers will be assigned at takeover. No implementation has started.

[A10] Donor prerequisite #95 is complete: [PR96 merged](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/96) as `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58` after two independent positive reviews, native/hosted validation, exact merge-tree verification and current-branch containment. Post-merge main CI passed; donor issue #95 is Closed/Done. [Completion evidence](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/96#issuecomment-5772201653).

The 16-bit `SRP_DOM_DEF_VID_P` top parameter now defaults to 2 and directly binds the existing child parameter. Runtime Domain adoption and Link Down/Up behavior remain unchanged. Parent #400 still owns the generated binding and parent-pin integration; this prerequisite does not complete #400 and no parent gitlink was changed. Existing builder-lane scheduling remains in force.

[A10] PP (protocol processor) follow-up links for the existing #400/#403 integration bundle:

- Fixture-hardening issue: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/97, delivered by the still-open https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/100 at audit time.
- Optional SRP diagram clarification: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/98
- Donor parameter-inventory documentation decision: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/99

PP95/PR96 already delivered the donor default-VID seam; these three issues do not reopen that work or change the #400/#403 criteria. PP97 changes verification guards only. PP98/99 remain donor documentation work. The parent still owns the generated configuration route and validated pin integration. No new parent implementation ticket is needed for these follow-ups.

[Complete PP (protocol processor) audit and donor ownership index](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/415#issuecomment-5772947045).

[A10] PARENT BUNDLE READINESS / INTEGRATION REVISION

The donor prerequisite is complete: [PP (protocol processor) issue #95 / PR #96 completion](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/96#issuecomment-5772201653) records both independent positives, complete native and hosted validation, actual-tree equality, direct containment and Closed/Done. Its merge is `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`.

For the already authorized #400 + #403 parent bundle, select that minimum merged PP revision for the required generated-VID parameter path. Later donor changes are separate scope. The existing donor historical audit exceptions remain disclosed; this selection does not repair them. The parent pin will move only inside this issue lane with the required parent integration tests, documentation and full review/gates. No pin changes in this scheduling step.

Both parent cards are still Ready. Reserve A177 Codex as executor, R249 cleared-context internal Codex and R250 external Opus as independent reviewers. Takeover follows the current #517/#372/#520 author work. The two recorded pre-implementation decisions remain the acceptance authority; the approved bundle is one implementation lane/PR for both issues. The unrelated #439 workflow lane continues to wait for #504 to land.

Opus is currently unavailable until September 25 at 16:00 Europe/Warsaw. Implementation and validation may proceed in the reserved lane, but the external review and complete merge bar remain mandatory. No bench result, source completion or parent integration pass is claimed here.

[A10] IMPLEMENTATION ASSIGNMENT FOR THE AUTHORIZED #400 + #403 BUNDLE

Scheduling decision: #520 author work is terminal and its isolated author slot is free. Use that slot for this Ready bundle while #517 finishes; the root, two authors and one reviewer remain the four active roles. This supersedes the earlier reservation to wait for both authors, without changing scope, acceptance or merge order.

A177 Codex takes one isolated lane from dev `483a133ed08867ea0d300d2b4a027b5b48a4282f`. R249 internal Codex and R250 external Opus are reserved as independent cleared-context reviewers. The two public pre-implementation decisions remain frozen acceptance; this is the previously authorized single branch/PR bundle. Use only merged PP (protocol processor) revision `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58` for the generated VID parameter path, as recorded in the readiness decision. Parent integration must prove the complete path and retain the donor historical audit disclosures. The gPTP processor pin stays at its current accepted revision.

The lane covers truthful SRP declarations, fixed factory presentation offset with legal runtime/restore behavior, the existing promiscuous RX posture, neutral reset words and exact declared output allocation. It does not implement a new receive filter policy or alter listener payload acceptance. Shared builder/firmware files with #504 are a recorded merge conflict risk; source preparation remains isolated and final current-dev validation follows the merge queue. The manager owns complete source/candidate gates, trusted act, hosted checks and merge/containment. External review remains pending Opus availability; source work is not approval.

[A177] TAKEN
Branch: 400-403-declaration-truth
Base: 483a133ed08867ea0d300d2b4a027b5b48a4282f
Executor: A177 Codex. Independent reviewers reserved: R249 internal Codex and R250 external Opus.
Authoritative references: REQUIREMENTS.md (REQ-CSR-01, REQ-CLS-03, REQ-MAC-02, REQ-VER-03); the pre-implementation decisions on #400 (comment 5770922734) and #403 (comment 5770922898); Milan v1.2 4.2.7.1.1, 4.2.7.2.1, 4.3.3.1/.2, 5.3.7.6 and 5.4.2.9/.10; donor #95 / PR96 completion.
Interpreted scope: the owner-authorized single-lane #400+#403 bundle, retaining the fixed SRP profile and real generated startup-VID path, live reset versus firmware boot controls, fixed per-output 2 ms factory defaults with legal runtime/restore changes, explicit existing promiscuous posture, neutral AAF/MAAP resets and exact declared-output allocation. Only PP pin 8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58 is adopted after verifying real-remote main reachability. Historical donor audit exceptions remain disclosed.
Validation plan: focused builder groups (including 18a-18d, 20a, 35 and defect-detecting controls), all-config entity/deploy shape checks, focused CSR/AAF/CRF/RX/MAAP/PP-wrapper integration with at most eight jobs and independently identified Verilator 5.050. The manager owns complete banks, trusted act, hosted evidence and final current-dev candidate gates. Source will remain committed, clean and unpublished for review.
Material citation correction: the local consolidated Milan v1.2 specification places SET_STREAM_INFO at 5.4.2.9 and GET_STREAM_INFO at 5.4.2.10. The #403 decision cites 5.4.2.6/.7, which actually cover GET_CONFIGURATION/SET_STREAM_FORMAT. Its explicit offset behavior agrees with 5.3.7.6 and 5.4.2.9/.10; implementation and evidence will cite those matching clauses. No acceptance behavior changes.
Blockers: none identified. Shared builder/firmware overlap with #504 remains a manager-owned merge risk. No implementation or review verdict is claimed.
